name: E-Way Bill Expiry Alerts for Transporters (India) – Telegram, WhatsApp & Email

parameters.content:
## 🚛 E-Way Bill Expiry Alerts for Transporters (India)

For transporters and logistics teams who track e-way bills in spreadsheets and only find out a bill has lapsed when a truck gets stopped at a checkpost. An expired EWB can mean a detained vehicle and a penalty, and the extension window is only open around the expiry time.

### How it works
Dispatchers add each bill from a form, or your ERP/GSP sends it by webhook. If Valid Upto isn't given, it's calculated from distance. Every 30 minutes the workflow checks all active bills and alerts at 12, 6 and 2 hours before expiry, at expiry, and as the extension window is closing. Ops always get Telegram, drivers get WhatsApp closer to expiry, and the dispatcher gets an email for the urgent ones.

Extensions, deliveries and cancellations are recorded through a second form or webhook, so alerts stop once a bill is handled.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet with tabs **EWB Tracker** and **Alert Log**.
2. Connect Google Sheets, Gmail and a Telegram bot, and add the bot to your ops group.
3. Add a WhatsApp Cloud API token as Header Auth and get an `ewb_expiry_alert` template approved.
4. Fill in all three **Set … Config** nodes: sheet ID, Telegram group ID, WhatsApp phone number ID and ops email.
5. Add a test bill expiring in a few hours, then activate.

## 📝 EWB Intake
Dispatchers add a bill through the form, or your ERP/GSP posts it to the webhook after generation. If Valid Upto is missing it's worked out from distance (1 day per 200 km, 20 km for ODC), ending at midnight IST.

## 🗂️ Dedupe & Start Tracking
Bills already in the tracker are skipped. New ones are added, and ops get a Telegram confirmation with the expiry time.

## ⏱️ Expiry Check
Every 30 minutes, active bills are compared with their Valid Upto time. A bill is flagged when it crosses an alert stage, and each stage fires only once.

## 🚨 Alerts by Urgency
Ops hear about every stage on Telegram. From 6 hours out the driver gets a WhatsApp, and from 2 hours out the dispatcher gets an email too.

## 🧾 Stage Tracking & Log
Saves the stage that was sent so the next run doesn't repeat it, and writes every alert to the log.

## ✏️ Status Updates
Ops record an extension, delivery, vehicle change or cancellation through the form, or your system posts it to the webhook. This keeps alerts from firing on bills that are already handled.

## ✅ Apply & Confirm
Checks the update against the tracker. Valid changes are written back, logged and confirmed on Telegram; anything that doesn't match, like an unknown EWB number, is rejected with the reason.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Keep the Telegram bot token, WhatsApp Cloud API token and Google OAuth2 in n8n credentials, never in node fields. Only add drivers who have agreed to WhatsApp alerts, and keep the webhook URLs private.
